HelioxSessionCookie.name: heliox_session
HelioxSessionCookie.description: Database-backed session cookie. The server sets it HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, path=/api/v1; clients must not read or store it in JavaScript.

x-heliox-security.session_authentication: Database-backed HttpOnly heliox_session cookie. Register, login, and system health are public; other /api/v1 operations require an active session.

csrf.validation: For authenticated state-changing requests, readable CSRF cookie and header must match and match the hash stored for the session.

x-heliox-security.identity_scope: Supplied user_id values are checked against the authenticated session identity.
x-heliox-security.task_ownership: Task detail/start/complete path IDs are checked against authenticated task ownership; service paths also scope task access.

x-heliox-optimization-boundary.response: Optimization evidence is returned through the typed response envelope with dynamic result details; this OpenAPI can describe only the declared envelope and does not invent internal result fields.
x-heliox-optimization-boundary.readiness: Production optimization is fail-closed on validated task duration/provenance, complete eligible trained-model task-hour predictions, matrix validity, and non-triviality; unavailable evidence remains NOT_READY.
x-heliox-optimization-boundary.quantum: The API exposes quantum status only. Direct QAOA execution is not exposed as an HTTP endpoint. The implemented solver is local software simulation; no physical hardware, quantum advantage, or speedup is claimed.
